name: LA Metro Youth Council
org: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority (Metro)
what_you_do: Teens help Metro learn what young people think about its plans, projects and programs. The council aims to listen, learn, engage, empower and build ridership.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17. The 2026 council has 27 members from nine areas, including the San Gabriel Valley, Central Los Angeles and the South Bay. No other rules are listed.
pay_detail: The page does not mention a stipend or pay
deadline_text: Recruitment for the 2027 council has closed. No dates are posted. A sign-up form on the page gets updates on youth opportunities.
how_to_apply: The page has no application. Use the update sign-up form, email metroyouthcouncil@metro.net or call 213.922.2852.
notes: Check the page for the next recruitment. The page does not say how often the council meets.
